rules.title: Task runs on folder open
rules.description: A `.vscode/tasks.json` or `*.code-workspace` task sets `runOptions.runOn` to `folderOpen`.

reasons.folderOpen: A VS Code task is set to run automatically when the folder is opened.

rules.title: Automatic tasks turned on
rules.description: Workspace settings set `task.allowAutomaticTasks` to `on`.

reasons.allowAutomaticTasks: Turns on automatic tasks so VS Code does not ask first.

rules.title: .vscode hidden from view
rules.description: `files.exclude` or `search.exclude` hides `.vscode` or `tasks.json`.

reasons.hidden: Workspace settings hide the .vscode folder or tasks.json from the file explorer or search.

rules.title: Task runs a non-script file with Node
rules.description: A task command runs a font, image or other non-script file with `node` (string or array form, `sh -c`, `-r`/`--import`, stdin).

reasons.nonScript: A VS Code task runs a file that is not a script (such as a font or image) with Node.
reasons.nonScriptViaNpm: A VS Code task runs an npm script that runs a file that is not a script with Node.

rules.title: Task downloads and runs code
rules.description: A task command downloads and pipes to a shell (`curl … | sh`, `wget … | bash`, PowerShell `iwr | iex`).

reasons.downloadAndRun: A VS Code task downloads something from the network and runs it.

rules.title: Task output hidden
rules.description: Task options hide output (`presentation.reveal: never`, `presentation.echo: false`, `hide: true`) on a task that also runs on folder open or runs a payload.

reasons.hiddenOutput: The task hides its terminal output, so nothing is visible while it runs.

rules.title: Install script added or changed
rules.description: `preinstall`, `install`, `postinstall` or `prepare` scripts added or changed (and `binding.gyp`, which npm builds on install).

reasons.installScript: A package.json script that npm runs automatically on install was added or changed.
reasons.nodeGyp: A binding.gyp file makes npm run a native build on install.

rules.title: Install script runs an unexpected file
rules.description: An install script runs a file that is not tracked source or a known build output.

reasons.nonScript: An install script runs a file that is not a script (such as a font or image).
reasons.missing: An install script runs a file that is not in the repository and is not a known build output.

rules.title: Dev container lifecycle command
rules.description: `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` `initializeCommand`, `onCreateCommand`, `postCreateCommand`, `postStartCommand` or `postAttachCommand` added or changed.

reasons.hostCommand: The initializeCommand hook runs on the host machine, outside the container, before the container starts.
reasons.lifecycle: A dev container command runs automatically when the container is created, started or attached.
reasons.payload: A dev container command downloads and runs code, or runs a file that is not a script with Node.

rules.title: AI agent hooks or auto-approved tools
rules.description: AI agent hooks and auto-approved tools: `.claude/settings*.json`, `.cursor/hooks.json`, `.mcp.json`, `.cursor/mcp.json`, `.vscode/mcp.json`.

reasons.hooks: Project settings define hooks that an AI coding agent runs automatically.
reasons.autoApprove: Project settings let an AI coding agent run any shell command without asking.
reasons.mcpAutoEnable: Project settings enable every MCP server in the repository without asking.
reasons.mcpServer: A project MCP configuration starts a local command when an AI agent loads the repository.

rules.title: Workflow added, changed or risky
rules.description: New or changed workflow under `.github/workflows/`, weighted up for `pull_request_target`, secrets passed to `curl`/`wget`, or posting to raw IPs.

reasons.changed: A GitHub Actions workflow was added or changed.
reasons.pullRequestTarget: The workflow runs on pull_request_target, with write access and secrets, for pull requests from forks.
reasons.checksOutPrHead: The workflow runs on pull_request_target and checks out the pull request's own code.
reasons.secretsToNetwork: A workflow step sends repository secrets to a network tool.
reasons.rawIp: A workflow step contacts a raw IP address.

rules.title: .gitignore stops ignoring .vscode or .env
rules.description: `.gitignore` change that stops ignoring `.vscode` or `.env`.

rules.title: Git hooks committed to the repository
rules.description: Git hooks committed to the repo (`.husky/`, `.githooks/`, `simple-git-hooks`) or a `core.hooksPath` setting.

reasons.committedHook: A git hook is committed to the repository and runs on commits, checkouts or pushes once installed.
reasons.hooksPath: A script or config points git at hooks inside the repository with core.hooksPath.

rules.title: Font file is not a font
rules.description: A file with a font extension whose bytes are not a real font (checked by format header fields, not just magic bytes).

reasons.notAFont: A file named like a font does not have a valid font header.

rules.title: Asset in an execution position
rules.description: An image or font asset referenced from an execution position (npm script, dev container hook, workflow step, shell script, `fork`, or read and evaluated).

reasons.command: A script or hook runs an image, font or other non-script file with Node.
reasons.fork: Code starts a new Node process from an image or font file.
reasons.evaluated: Code reads an image or font file and builds code from it at runtime.

rules.title: Code after the module body in a config file
rules.description: Code after the module body in JS/TS config files, especially after a long run of whitespace.

reasons.tail: A config file has code after its export statement.
reasons.paddedTail: A config file has code after its export statement, pushed out of view by a long run of whitespace.

rules.title: Whitespace padding or very long line in source
rules.description: Very long lines or heavy whitespace padding in source and config files.

reasons.padding: A source line has code pushed far to the right by a long run of whitespace.
reasons.longLine: A source file that is otherwise readable has a single extremely long line.

rules.title: Runtime code construction in config or route code
rules.description: Runtime code construction (`eval`, `new Function`, `vm.runIn*`, detached hidden `child_process` spawns) in config or route files.

reasons.eval: A config or route file calls eval.
reasons.function: A config or route file builds a function from a string with Function.
reasons.vm: A config or route file compiles and runs code with the vm module.
reasons.hiddenSpawn: A config or route file starts a detached, hidden background process.

rules.title: Encoded URL in .env with code that sends the environment
rules.description: Base64-encoded URLs in `.env` files combined with code that sends `process.env` over the network.

reasons.encodedUrl: An environment file stores a URL encoded as base64.
reasons.envSent: Code sends the whole process environment over the network.

rules.title: Propagation script rewrites history
rules.description: Propagation scripts that rewind the clock, amend the last commit and force-push.

reasons.amendForcePush: A script amends the last commit and force-pushes it.
reasons.rewritesHistory: A script rewinds the clock, amends the last commit and force-pushes, hiding a change inside existing history.

rules.title: Known-bad file hash
rules.description: File hashes on the known-bad list (synced from the Dome Registry and public advisories).

reasons.knownHash: This file is byte-for-byte identical to a known malicious file.

rules.title: Published campaign marker
rules.description: Published campaign markers (for example the signatures in OpenSourceMalware's PolinRider YARA rule).

reasons.marker: This file contains a byte sequence published as a marker of a known malware campaign.

rules.title: Known malicious npm package
rules.description: Dependencies on known malicious npm packages.

reasons.dependency: package.json depends on a package published as part of a known malware campaign.
reasons.lockfile: The lockfile resolves a package published as part of a known malware campaign.

rules.title: Known staging or C2 domain in an executable position
rules.description: Known staging and C2 domains in executable positions (tasks, scripts, hooks, workflows, config and route code).

reasons.domain: Code that runs automatically contacts a domain known to host malware or command-and-control servers.

rules.title: Code reads Stellar CLI identities
rules.description: Code that reads Stellar CLI identities (`~/.config/stellar/identity/*.toml`, plaintext unless created with `--secure-store`).

reasons.reads: Project code refers to the Stellar CLI identity folder, where secret keys are stored.
reasons.exfiltrates: Project code refers to the Stellar CLI identity folder and also makes network requests.

rules.title: Code reads browser wallet extension storage
rules.description: Code that reads browser wallet extension storage (Freighter and others) from a project file.

reasons.reads: Project code refers to browser extension storage, where wallet extensions keep their vaults.
reasons.exfiltrates: Project code refers to browser extension storage and also makes network requests.

rules.title: Hard-coded Stellar secret key
rules.description: Hard-coded Stellar secret keys (`S…` strkeys with a valid checksum) committed to the repo.

reasons.secretKey: A Stellar secret key is committed to the repository.
